description: This Java class defines the SimpleDosingInstructions, a subclass of BaseDosingInstructions, representing detailed dosing instructions for medication orders within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes methods for generating a dosing instruction string, applying instructions to a DrugOrder, retrieving instructions, and validating the data.

classes.name: SimpleDosingInstructions
classes.description: A class representing simple, detailed dosing instructions with properties like dose, units, route, frequency, duration, and instructions, with methods for string formatting, setting, getting, validation, and integration with DrugOrder.

methods.name: getDosingInstructionsAsString
methods.description: Constructs and returns a human-readable string representation of the dosing instructions, localized according to the provided Locale.

methods.name: setDosingInstructions
methods.description: Applies the current dosing instruction properties to a given DrugOrder object.

methods.name: getDosingInstructions
methods.description: Creates and returns a SimpleDosingInstructions object populated with data from a given DrugOrder, ensuring the dosing type matches.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks the validity of the dosing instruction data within a DrugOrder, adding errors if required fields are missing or invalid.
